pages.text: Pip sits by the plant pots.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow perched beside a row of plant pots in the greenhouse.

pages.text: A seed sits in a pot.
pages.illustration: Close view of one small seed resting in dark soil in a pot.

pages.text: Pip trots in to look each day.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping in through the greenhouse door.

pages.text: On day one, the pot is still.
pages.illustration: The pot of soil sitting plain and unchanged, nothing showing yet.

pages.text: On the next day, a bit pops up.
pages.illustration: A tiny green tip just poking up out of the soil in the pot.
The small green shoot now standing taller above the soil.

pages.text: Pip is late to look one day.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hurrying in through the greenhouse door, a little late.

pages.text: When Pip gets there, the plant is big.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow stopping in surprise at how big the plant has grown.

pages.text: The plant is green and big.
pages.illustration: The plant now tall with several wide green leaves.

pages.text: Pip claps. He did not miss much.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow flapping his wings happily beside the tall green plant.
